message: Imported canonical English Task 1 fixture Context 'campus-wiki/route-changes' into profile 'task-1-campus-authority'.

ee271f65-7387-52f2-8e6e-23ad7f224f03.content: The rear entrance on the third floor of the Main Building connects directly to the pedestrian route leading to the Central Library.

8a953afd-7a48-52e8-b48a-38d8c49b55c5.content: With your back to the main entrance, Outdoor Parking Lot A is on the left.

b54ac954-0a84-502c-a096-a4f85a0d317a.content: With your back to the main entrance, the West Complex is on the left.

5e23ba3e-d573-54c3-99b0-fea607a63e46.content: With your back to the main entrance, the Humanities Building is on the right.

9f4c539b-1205-5ed7-a441-d9a46615ea01.content: The Student Centre is behind the Central Library.

8f2f2422-0ac3-5dc2-8a17-871c0deedcf3.content: The Outdoor Parking Lot A–Main Building–Central Library route is usually short.

6ded9e53-4073-5911-82c6-b3981c2daf98.content: The Outdoor Parking Lot A–Main Building–Central Library route has a long indoor section.

494bc428-f0be-5a21-9475-14fc405c9fda.content: The route from Outdoor Parking Lot C through the Student Centre accessible entrance to the west entrance of the Central Library does not pass through the Main Building.

4369c450-1ca1-58e7-b98f-c087552a0a5a.content: In summer, students prefer the air-conditioned indoor route from the first to the third floor of the Main Building over the outdoor route.

02df0e1e-fc32-5136-a0c2-5af11f99293e.content: Recommend only routes that are currently confirmed to be open.

759a38f7-7b7f-5eae-bbec-f00df27c9f4b.content: Explain the distinction between the standard shortest route and the accessible route.

78ebae58-9630-5674-90e7-a35951661d19.content: The route guidance agent can compare routes using stored geographic information.

f0864b5f-4148-5c8c-a778-de0a028146d7.content: The route guidance agent cannot check congestion in real time.

056cce65-dd73-50e6-8745-27d4d71effb1.content: The route guidance agent cannot check for movable obstacles.

084210ca-d235-52d4-9801-3e78c7d53454.content: The route guidance agent cannot check in real time for newly installed temporary signs or movable control barriers at the time of inquiry.

1fa0cf4f-6bc2-50f6-90a7-871b286b00bf.content: There is no continuous accessible route that a wheelchair can use in the direction of the stairs on the right side of the Main Building.

c33f2c68-d304-51e0-8489-7e8876775cfd.content: The detour from the stairs on the right side of the Main Building to the Student Centre is long.

f9832b10-f7cf-5ac0-a7bc-9e9da6ca3646.content: Mobility support companions prefer the indoor route through the Main Building to the Central Library because it is less affected by weather.

fd111f85-255e-5c35-acfb-b860f35cc4a8.content: The public campus map shows building entrances and pedestrian paths between buildings.

4bad21e5-cc32-5995-93fd-d0938a41d427.content: The public campus map separately marks step-free accessible routes.

d1aaec66-fff8-5270-b939-cd8877f75339.content: The pedestrian path in front of the Main Building's main entrance has a sign indicating the direction of the accessible route.

b7802de6-8e3c-5e90-8e2e-b7d949009352.content: A step-free pedestrian path runs from Outdoor Parking Lot C to the Student Centre accessible entrance.

065b33d3-3aae-5aa2-b9f0-f779f612e0ea.content: An accessible route runs from the Student Centre to the west entrance of the Central Library.

79728c8e-66d0-574d-aeee-2e6e4a928db3.content: There is an above-ground pedestrian path from the West Complex to the Main Building's main entrance.

41f16b3e-4ab3-5f38-9942-7e8896fec3b6.content: The pedestrian path from the Humanities Building to the Main Building's main entrance passes in front of the stairs on the right side of the Main Building.

2af1d276-7a46-514d-b8c8-cd9f1e2a9ef2.content: Using the elevator from the first-floor lobby of the Main Building provides step-free access to the level of the third-floor rear entrance.

cae9af0e-9225-5193-b581-5b2d8096fc14.content: The escalator route in the Main Building includes a section where stairs cannot be avoided.

a1617fa2-fa36-5af1-91c9-a8924ae1f5a9.content: When step-free travel is required, direct people to the elevator route rather than the escalator route.

03c25e0f-3cd1-5a27-a806-0d09664a3fc3.content: The elevator closest to the Main Building's main entrance is inside the first-floor lobby.

6fad00c2-1f97-5377-8a3a-b36d19705d4b.content: The above-ground route between the Main Building and the Central Library has a rest bench midway.

c3558237-458f-5487-8718-0c48b9bdf568.content: Solbit Plaza is between the Main Building's main entrance and the West Complex.

09862f9d-91cd-5e36-b6b9-b042b5d84d5b.content: When it rains or snows, travel time on sloped outdoor pedestrian paths may be longer than usual.

034676e0-f7b6-52ea-90a3-e6d3f656bc2f.content: Snow removal personnel judge that when it snows, major accessible routes must be cleared before other pedestrian paths.

6c4eeef5-0905-5923-b201-666b504b95f1.content: Students going to the library after parking prefer the familiar, short Outdoor Parking Lot A–Main Building–Central Library route.

4dcddb86-e56c-552a-810d-c04a1934b475.content: During class change times, pedestrian traffic increases between the third floor of the Main Building and the Central Library.

ddcc1848-f9df-5772-9e9a-0c6ed42e557a.content: First-time visitors find directions based on visible facilities easier to understand than directions based on building numbers.

0a78908e-a479-5e5a-b54e-b09f2cb1f7bc.content: Because of the sloped terrain, first-time visitors sometimes confuse the levels of the Main Building's first-floor main entrance and third-floor rear entrance.

80355a5f-5170-59b1-82b1-517c5c20a1bb.content: Delivery drivers consider designated service routes that do not mix with pedestrians more predictable and safer.

27e0d8cf-02ac-5b42-8970-da451a27e055.content: The route guidance agent cannot check on-site congestion in real time and can compare posted detours to identify routes with fewer branches.

08d5128e-e371-5251-a3e8-acf488ccbc59.content: The route guidance agent can distinguish stair routes from elevator routes on the public map.

d7a22205-1d0a-5106-a764-fc2e97769bc8.content: The route guidance agent cannot measure on-site pedestrian traffic at the time of inquiry.

2db61a85-42af-5b31-b070-5ba2ef965cc7.content: The route guidance agent cannot guarantee an individual user's travel time.

5a6b05a2-e14b-5b88-a9b7-58db2e3b2845.content: Check the current notice for the destination entrance before giving directions.

49a1ffe4-b705-5503-9853-e755bef73239.content: Do not recommend staff-only passages as detours to general users.

2742f895-9179-5e72-bef7-2ab08c68db2c.content: If the shortest route has stairs, also present an available accessible route.

3b535b19-637b-5f2a-8441-8c509e7a1bfa.content: In an emergency, instruct people to follow on-site evacuation signs and safety personnel's directions rather than general wayfinding guidance.

2f6bcece-e018-5b44-8936-430839892e49.content: A pedestrian path from the West Gate stop to the Main Building's main entrance runs through Solbit Plaza.

675f922d-084f-54bd-bc38-f7aae69a370b.content: There is a step-free route from the shuttle stop in front of the Student Centre to the west entrance of the Central Library.

30e5c146-ea97-5317-bf6f-dedbffaeaafa.content: Bicycle users dismount at the designated rack on the edge of Solbit Plaza and proceed on foot.

da43a5f5-41af-5a8a-b867-b854fe4c4ae5.content: Do not suggest informal shortcuts that are not on the public map as default routes.
